MDG.note: Mentions the digital unit's own staff skills only, no civil-service training programme.
No programme teaching the public digital skills or measured skills share is stated.
Only a passing mention of a digital transformation roadmap; no strategy is described.

facts.fact: Public Digital reports Madagascar's Digital Governance Unit built the multi-channel public services portal Torolalana, whose in-person channel Mahatoky has been piloted in 4 post offices, supports 400 processes and holds 206 citizen accounts, with transactional services still to be added to the informative ones offered.

systems.owner: Digital Governance Unit, Ministry of Digital Development
systems.tiers: digital channel, telephone channel, physical channel (Mahatoky)

systems.owner: Digital Governance Unit with Paositra Malagasy

facts.fact: Public Digital says Madagascar's Digital Governance Unit, within the Ministry of Digital Development, is responsible for managing digital projects across the government's ministries and digitising public services, with a multidisciplinary team.

MDG.note: Land titles are mentioned only as a slow process; no land register system is described.
